shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a flat rectangular panel
a plant/frond-like motif with symmetrically paired leaflets
repeated units of the same motif arranged in a series
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both panels carry shallow relief motifs repeated in a series, and both contain a frond/plant-like element with paired leaflets flanking a central axis, plus some hooked or spiralling forms. But A's content is dominated by animals — quadrupeds in profile, birds, a duck-like creature — set in stacked horizontal registers above a zigzag band, whereas B is purely vegetal: a continuous vertical stem bearing palmettes and volutes with no creatures at all, so the subject matter is essentially unrelated.
